title: Fuel Tank Capacity — 5.0L 32V Ti-VCT
introduction:
I start with the engine name, then read across to its tank capacity. A shared row applies to every engine named on that row. Use the populated engine-specific entry; the blank general row supplies no additional value. Read the gallon and litre units with their respective figures.

The table is the tank’s size label, not a health report for the fuel system. It gives capacity, while fuel level, delivery pressure and pump operation require different information. No tank-service or diagnostic procedure is taught here.

edits.why: Engine identity determines the applicable row. Keeping each figure with its printed unit prevents the capacity lookup from becoming a unit mix-up.
